row.evidence: SketchUp offers SSO only through Trimble ID federation (SAML or OIDC), where 'Trimble ID creates an account the first time a user signs in'; members are otherwise added one by one or by .csv, and no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Users sign in with Trimble ID; large accounts can use Trimble ID federation (SAML 2.0 or OIDC; Entra ID, AD FS, Google, Okta), which creates accounts just in time. Pricing page puts SSO/Federation under volume purchasing for teams; Trimble help calls federation a free add-on. Members are added in the Account Management Portal individually or by CSV (max 200 per upload). No SCIM found in the SketchUp help sitemap, pricing page or Trimble federation docs, so none by absence.

open_questions: No SCIM endpoint is documented for SketchUp or Trimble ID; confirm with Trimble whether federated customers can deprovision other than by deleting accounts in a federated domain.
No public user-management API for the SketchUp Account Management Portal was found.
Whether Trimble ID federation is restricted to volume-purchasing customers (pricing page) or free to all (Trimble help) is unclear.
